prompt:
A flat, matte design sketch of a full desktop web page, tall portrait format showing the entire page from top to bottom as one continuous scroll, shown straight on with no perspective, no device frame, no browser chrome, no drop shadows, no gloss, no photorealism. Deliberately unfinished, like a designer's layout study rendered in flat color blocks.

Palette, used exactly: warm aged-paper off-white background (#F7F3ED), dark warm ink (#2A231C), one muted slate blue accent (#365778), and a deep near-black warm brown (#171310) for solid blocks. No other colors. A faint regular dot grid over the paper background.

There are no photographs, no screenshots, no user interface chrome and no browser windows anywhere. Everything is typography and simple ruled shapes.

The page has four distinct zones stacked vertically. Keep the transitions between zones obvious.

ZONE ONE, the top, compact:
A thin header strip with the word Narraitor small on the left. Below it a serif headline across the left half reading exactly: Play a story in any world you can imagine. Under the headline one short greeked line, then a compact solid slate-blue rectangular button.

ZONE TWO, wide and horizontal:
Two wide paired rows, one above the other, separated by a thick horizontal rule. Each row splits into two unequal columns. The left column is narrow, about one third, and is a solid deep near-black warm brown block with a few short sparse ragged pale lines inside it. The right column is wide, about two thirds, on plain paper, holding one bold heading bar and then seven or eight soft indistinct horizontal lines of full measure. A small slate blue triangle marker points from the left block toward the right column. The two rows differ visibly in the ragged shape of their left-hand lines.

A THICK FULL-WIDTH HORIZONTAL DIVIDER separates zone two from zone three, with generous empty paper above and below it.

ZONE THREE, narrow and centred, deliberately a different shape from zone two:
Everything here is centred in a column about two thirds of the page width, with no dark blocks at all. First a modest block of greeked prose, five or six indistinct lines. Then three stacked wide rectangles with thin dark hairline borders and generous padding, separated by clear gaps, each containing one thick heavy horizontal bar. The middle rectangle has a slate blue left edge and its bar rendered in slate blue. These three rectangles are the largest elements on the whole page. Below them a short divider, then another block of greeked prose with one of its lines rendered as a thick slate blue bar and a small bracketed marker in the left margin beside it.

ZONE FOUR, the bottom, compact:
A single wide bordered strip on a very slightly warmer paper fill, holding two short greeked lines on the left and a solid slate-blue rectangular button on the right. Below it a thin footer strip with three small greeked links.

The only legible text anywhere is the word Narraitor and the headline. Every other text region is greeked: indistinct horizontal bars standing in for words, not real letters. Do not render invented prices, dates, statistics, logos, faces, or photographs. Critically: do not render any word from these instructions as visible text in the image. No labels, no annotations, no zone names, no words like LARGE or PROSE or CHOICE anywhere.

The overall feeling is one long printed page on good paper: a wide comparison section up top, then a narrow dramatic section below it, clearly different in shape so they never blur together.
